input:
learner text: 秋季期间，他这个没有礼貌的人每天爬上本树，来偷走我兄弟姐妹。
quote: 本树
note on the quote: not very natural
part p0: comment [ref p0/note] 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news, also it indicates the author owns the tree, which is not the fact: the author is a pear, who does not own the whole pear tree. 爬上这棵树。

edits.note: 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news, also it indicates the author owns the tree, which is not the fact: the author is a pear, who does not own the whole pear tree. 爬上这棵树。
edits.reason: teacher comments that 本树 is unnatural and proposes 这棵树
